verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
As I rise, strength of God
Go before, lift me up

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
As I wake, eyes of God
Look upon, be my sight

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines:
As I wait, heart of God
Satisfy and sustain

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines:
As I hear, voice of God
Lead me on, be my guide
Be my guide

verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
Above and below me
Before and behind me
In every eye that sees me
Christ be all around me

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
Above and below me
Before and behind me
In every eye that sees me
Christ be all around me

verse.name: v3a
verse.lines:
As I go, hand of God
My defence, by my side

verse.name: v3b
verse.lines:
As I rest, breath of God
Fall upon, bring me peace
Bring me peace

verse.name: b1
verse.lines:
Your life, Your death
Your blood was shed
For every moment
Every moment
